sermon.title: Was Eternal Life Recorded in History Before the Creation of the World? — September 4, 2022
sermon.series: Before the Foundation of the World
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: God, who cannot lie, promised eternal life before time began. That higher promise gave Adam and Eve a second chance, sent Christ to preach to the spirits in prison from Noah’s day, and makes judgment more tolerable for Sodom. So we must speak up and make disciples.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Worship and an unattributed prophetic word before the message (~30:10).
